支払手数料 is a standard Japanese financial accounting expense line item (勘定科目) typically classified under selling, general, and administrative expenses (SG&A) or non-operating expenses, correctly categorizing it as an account.
Under Japanese accounting standards, 保険料 (insurance expense/premium) is a standard expense account line item appearing under SG&A expenses or manufacturing overhead.
租税公課 (Taxes and public charges) is a standard selling, general, and administrative expense account (勘定科目) on the income statement.

貸倒引当金繰入 (Provision of allowance for doubtful accounts) is an expense line item (勘定科目) recorded on the Income Statement under SG&A or non-operating/extraordinary expenses, which fits the definition of 'account'.

貸倒損失 (bad debts expense) is an income statement expense/loss line item (費用・損失勘定), making 'account' the proper semantic class. 'tax_loss' is reserved for statutory tax loss concepts such as loss carryforwards (繰越欠損金).

研究開発費 (Research and development expenses) is an expense line item (勘定科目) under Selling, General and Administrative Expenses (販売費及び一般管理費) or manufacturing costs in financial accounting, correctly classified as an account.
業務委託費 is a standard expense account title (勘定科目) recorded in the income statement under selling, general, and administrative expenses (SG&A) or cost of sales.
雑費 (miscellaneous expenses) is a standard selling, general, and administrative expense account item in financial accounting and bookkeeping.
営業利益 (operating profit) is a standard line item (表示科目) on the profit and loss statement (損益計算書) under J-GAAP and international accounting standards, fitting the 'account' semantic class.
営業損失 is an income statement presentation line item (表示科目) representing a negative operating balance under Japanese GAAP/financial reporting standards, fitting the definition of 'account'.

営業外収益 (non-operating income) is a standard income statement line item/category representing revenues from non-core activities (such as interest, dividends, and exchange gains), which accurately falls under the semantic class 'account'.
「営業外費用」は損益計算書（P/L）における費用区分・勘定科目区分（経常利益の計算要素）であり、taxonomy上の「account（財務諸表の勘定科目・表示科目）」として完全に合致しています。
支払利息 (interest expense) is an income statement line item categorized under non-operating expenses (営業外費用), accurately matching the account class.
社債利息 is an expense line item (specifically non-operating expenses / 営業外費用) on the income statement representing interest incurred on corporate bonds issued, not a securities investment.
為替差益 (foreign exchange gains) is a standard non-operating income line item (営業外収益の勘定科目) on the income statement, making account the appropriate semantic class.
為替差損 (Foreign exchange loss) is a standard non-operating expense account (営業外費用 / 勘定科目) on the profit and loss statement under Japanese accounting standards.
経常利益 (Ordinary profit) is a standard income statement (P/L) line item and subtotal category under Japanese GAAP, fitting the definition of an accounting line item ('account').
特別利益 (extraordinary income) is a standard income statement line item and category under Japanese GAAP, correctly classified as an account.
特別損失 (extraordinary losses) is a standard income statement (損益計算書) category/line item representing non-recurring losses, fitting the ontology definition for 'account'.
減損損失 (impairment loss) is an income statement expense line item, typically categorized under extraordinary losses (特別損失) in Japanese GAAP, which accurately falls under 'account'.
税引前当期純利益 (Profit before income taxes) is a standard financial statement line item (損益計算書表示科目) representing income before tax expense, which accurately fits the 'account' semantic class.

In the accounting domain, 法人税等 (short for 法人税、住民税及び事業税) is an income statement expense line item representing current income tax expense deducted from pre-tax income, making 'account' the precise semantic class rather than 'tax'.
法人税等調整額 is not a statutory tax type, but an income statement presentation line item (勘定科目／表示科目) under tax effect accounting representing deferred income taxes.
当期純利益 is the bottom-line presentation and reporting item (表示科目) of the income statement (損益計算書), properly classified under 'account'.

包括利益 (Comprehensive Income) is a standard financial statement line item reported on the statement of comprehensive income, representing the net change in equity from non-owner sources, correctly categorized as an account.

1株当たり当期純利益 (EPS) is a financial indicator and per-share metric calculated from net income and shares outstanding. It is not an accounting ledger item (勘定科目) used in double-entry bookkeeping, so classifying it as 'account' is incorrect; it belongs to 'metric'.

audit.term: 自己資本当期純利益率
audit.reason: 自己資本当期純利益率 (ROE) is a standard financial ratio/metric used in financial analysis and corporate valuation to measure profitability relative to shareholders' equity.
複式簿記は貸借対照表や損益計算書の勘定科目（account）ではなく、取引の二面性に着目して借方・貸方に同額を記帳する会計手法・記帳方式であるため、accounting_method（または業務処理上の枠組みとして procedure）が適切です。
仕訳 (journal entry / journalizing) refers to the bookkeeping process or record of debit/credit classification, not a balance sheet or income statement account title (勘定科目).
借方は複式簿記における仕訳や勘定口座の左側（デビット）を指す記帳区分・概念であり、特定の資産・負債・費用等の具体的な勘定科目（account）ではないため。

貸方 (Credit) denotes the right-hand entry side/position in double-entry bookkeeping, not a specific ledger line item or financial statement line item (勘定科目). Classifying it as 'account' is incorrect; it is a structural bookkeeping concept.
「勘定科目」は会計帳簿や財務諸表における記録単位・表示科目（資産・負債・純資産・収益・費用）そのものおよびその総称を指し、セマンティッククラスとして「account」が最も適切です。
総勘定元帳（General Ledger）は個別勘定科目（account）ではなく、全取引を勘定科目別に記録・集計する主要な会計帳簿（帳簿書類）であるため、documentが適切です。
試算表 is an internal accounting report or worksheet used to verify ledger balances, not an individual ledger account line item.
決算整理仕訳 refers to adjusting journal entries made at fiscal year-end, representing an accounting procedure/process rather than a balance sheet or income statement account line item (勘定科目).

会計方針 (Accounting policies) refers to the specific principles, bases, conventions, rules, and practices applied by an entity in preparing and presenting financial statements. It is not an account (勘定科目) or financial statement line item.
「会計上の見積り」は財務諸表作成時において不確実性のある資産・負債等の金額を合理的に推計・算出する算定・評価プロセス（会計処理手続）であり、貸借対照表や損益計算書の個別の勘定科目（account）ではないため。
「継続企業の前提」（ゴーイング・コンサーン）は財務諸表作成における基本的な公準・会計前提（accounting principle/concept）であり、貸借対照表や損益計算書の勘定科目（account）ではない。
「内部統制」は財務報告の信頼性や業務の適正性を担保するために企業内に構築される体制・ガバナンスの枠組み（プロセス・実務慣行）であり、財務諸表の勘定科目（account）ではありません。
監査法人は公認会計士法に基づき設立される監査業務を提供する法人組織（専門サービス法人）であり、財務諸表上の勘定科目（account）ではない。
監査基準 (Auditing Standards) represents a set of professional and regulatory norms established by the Business Accounting Council for financial audits, not a ledger account line item (account).
無限定適正意見は監査報告書において公認会計士・監査法人が表明する監査意見の種類（クリーン・オピニオン）であり、貸借対照表や損益計算書等の勘定科目（account）ではありません。監査意見を表すクラス（audit_opinion）として分類するのが適切です。
限定付適正意見 (qualified opinion) is an auditor's formal opinion expressed in an independent audit report, not a financial statement ledger account (勘定科目).
不適正意見 (adverse opinion) is a formal category of auditor's opinion expressed in an independent auditor's report, not a financial ledger account (勘定科目).
意見不表明 (Disclaimer of opinion) は財務諸表の勘定科目 (account) ではなく、監査報告書において監査人が表明する監査意見の類型（監査意見区分）であるため。
見積書 is a standard commercial transaction document (business form/quotation) exchanged between parties, perfectly matching the 'document' category.
相見積もり (あいみつ) refers to the standard Japanese commercial and procurement practice of soliciting comparative price estimates from multiple vendors before placing an order or awarding a contract.
発注書 (purchase order) is a standard commercial business form/document exchanged between trading partners to formalize an order, perfectly aligning with the 'document' semantic class.
注文請書 is a formal commercial business document issued by a seller confirming acceptance of a purchase order, fitting squarely into the document class for business forms and transaction records.
納品書 is a standard commercial transaction document used to confirm the delivery of goods or services, fitting accurately within the 'document' semantic class.
受領書 is a standard commercial document and business voucher acknowledging receipt of goods, items, or payments, accurately classified as a document.

検収 represents the operational and administrative workflow of inspecting and formally accepting delivered goods, systems, or services in accordance with contract terms, directly governing the timing of revenue and expense recognition.
検収書 (acceptance certificate) is a standard commercial document issued to confirm the inspection and formal acceptance of delivered goods or services.
請求書 (invoice/bill) is a standard commercial business document used to request payment for goods or services, precisely matching the `document` class.
領収書 (receipt) is an archetypal business and commercial document evidencing the receipt of funds, fitting the definition and taxonomy of 'document'.
前金 refers to money/funds paid in advance (substantively corresponding to the accounting items 前払金/前渡金 or 前受金) rather than an administrative workflow or procedure.

着手金 (retainer fee / initial commencement fee) is a monetary remuneration or advance payment concept (subsumed under accounts such as 前受金, 前渡金, or 支払手数料/売上), not a business workflow or operational procedure.
手付金 (earnest money/contract deposit) is a monetary line item/deposit asset or liability (typically booked under 前渡金/前払金 or 前受金 in financial accounting), not an administrative or operational workflow.
「締日」は請求・支払・給与計算等において対象期間を区切る基準日（カットオフ日）およびその商慣行であり、一連の業務工程・作業そのものを表す「procedure（手続・処理）」ではない。手続に該当するのは「締め処理」であり、述語結合の観点からも締日は「実施する」ではなく「迎える・設定する・過ぎる」等と共起するため、商習慣・取引条件を表す「business_practice」に分類するのが適切。

支払期日 (payment due date / deadline) denotes a specific contractual or statutory temporal condition agreed upon in commercial transactions (e.g., under the Subcontract Act or sales contracts), rather than an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

振込手数料 (bank transfer fee) is a financial charge/expense item commonly treated as an account line item (or sub-account under 支払手数料) in bookkeeping and financial management, not an operational or administrative workflow.

納期 specifies the contractual delivery date or deadline agreed upon in commercial transactions, representing a contractual condition/term rather than an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
督促状 refers to the written notice or demand letter itself, denoted by the suffix 状. While 督促 or 督促手続 constitutes a procedure, the physical or electronic notice sent to a debtor is a document.
催告書 is a formal written demand or notice issued to demand performance or payment (often prior to legal action), making 'document' the correct semantic class.
割戻し represents a volume rebate ledger deduction against sales or purchases, classifying it as an accounting line item rather than a procedure.

値引き (price reduction/discount) is a commercial pricing action or negotiation practice, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure). In an accounting ledger context, it represents a contra-revenue/contra-expense deduction (account), but within general business commerce it belongs to business_practice.

In commercial and business operations, '返品' primarily denotes the operational workflow and administrative process of returning purchased merchandise (sales/purchase return), fitting the 'procedure' class for operational workflows.
クレーム対応 refers to the operational workflow and handling process for managing customer complaints and claims, making 'procedure' the appropriate semantic class.

与信管理 (credit management / credit risk control) refers to an operational and administrative workflow involving counterparty screening, credit line setting, and continuous risk monitoring, appropriately classified as procedure under the provided taxonomy.
与信限度額 is a monetary threshold or credit exposure limit established for a business counterparty, not an operational workflow or administrative procedure.
取引基本契約 refers to a basic transaction agreement or master agreement setting continuous business terms between commercial parties, accurately classified as a 'contract'.
個別契約 refers to an individual agreement or purchase order concluded pursuant to a master/basic agreement (基本契約), which directly falls under the 'contract' semantic class.

相殺 (set-off/offset) is an operational, legal, and accounting settlement procedure under the Civil Code and commercial practice by which mutual debts and claims are extinguished at corresponding amounts.
掛け売り (selling on credit / open account) represents a standard commercial transaction method and B2B settlement practice (商慣行・取引形態) rather than an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).
期日厳守 (strict adherence to deadlines) is a workplace behavioral norm, discipline, or standard business code of conduct rather than an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
取締役会 (Board of Directors) is a statutory collegiate governance body/organ under the Companies Act, not an individual role or position (person_role), which properly applies to 取締役 (Director).
取締役 constitutes a statutory corporate officer and board member under the Companies Act of Japan, which directly maps to the person_role semantic class.
代表取締役 (Representative Director) designates a statutory officer role under the Companies Act of Japan, correctly classified as person_role.
社外取締役 denotes a statutory corporate officer position defined under the Companies Act (会社法第2条第15号), making person_role the precise and appropriate semantic classification.
Under the Japanese Companies Act, 監査役 is a statutory corporate officer responsible for auditing directors' execution of duties and corporate accounting, accurately classified as person_role.
「執行役員」は企業の業務執行を担当する役職・地位を指す人的役割概念であり、person_roleとして適切に分類されています。
常務取締役 designates a statutory board director position with executive management duties under corporate governance and Japanese business practice, precisely matching the person_role class.
専務取締役 represents a corporate executive/director title, which accurately fits the person_role class under corporate governance and Japanese business taxonomy.

取締役会議事録 represents the written record/minutes of a board of directors meeting. Classifying it as 'document' (or 'statutory_document' under the Companies Act) accurately captures its ontological nature.
定時株主総会は会社法第296条に基づき定時開催される最高意思決定機関の会議体（株主総会）であり、企業や官公庁等の組織体を指す「organization」に分類するのは不適切です。「corporate_meeting」または機関としての側面を重視する場合は「corporate_organ」が適切です。
An extraordinary shareholders' meeting is a statutory corporate governance procedure or event under the Companies Act, not an ongoing institutional organization.
招集通知 refers to the formal written notice convening a general meeting of shareholders or board meeting, which directly aligns with the 'document' category (explicitly covering meeting notices).
議決権 (voting rights) represents a statutory corporate and shareholder right (共益権) under the Companies Act, not an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
株主名簿 (shareholder registry) is a mandatory corporate register governed under Article 121 of the Companies Act (会社法), making it an official statutory record/document rather than a procedure.
「委任状」 (Power of Attorney / Proxy) is a formal legal instrument/business document used to grant representative authority, accurately fitting the semantic class 'document'.

善管注意義務 (duty of care of a good manager) is a fundamental statutory/fiduciary legal obligation imposed on mandataries and corporate officers (Civil Code Art. 644, Companies Act Art. 330), not merely a contract clause.

忠実義務 (duty of loyalty) is a statutory fiduciary duty imposed on directors and fiduciaries under Article 355 of the Companies Act and Civil Code principles, not merely a contractual provision or clause (contract_clause).
「競業避止義務」は会社法上の取締役等の法定義務や労働契約等に基づく作為・不作為義務（法的義務）を指し、契約条文そのものを表す「競業避止条項（contract_clause）」とは概念的に区別されます。下流の述語結合（義務を負う、違反する、免除するなど）を適正に制御するためにも `legal_obligation` とするべきです。

内部統制 (Internal Control) is an overarching framework and system established by management to ensure operational effectiveness, compliance, and reliable financial reporting under the Companies Act and Financial Instruments and Exchange Act (J-SOX), not a discrete administrative or operational workflow (procedure).
コンプライアンス（法令遵守・企業倫理）は企業経営や内部統制の基本方針・行動規範（コーポレートガバナンス概念）であり、個別の事務的・運用的ワークフローを指す「procedure」ではない。
「内部通報制度」は個別の事務手続きや作業工程（procedure）ではなく、公益通報者保護法やコーポレートガバナンス・コードに基づき組織内に整備・運用されるコンプライアンスおよび内部統制の制度的枠組み・体制（compliance_system / internal_control）であるため。
「利益相反取引」は会社法（第356条・第365条）に規定される、取締役と会社の間で利害が対立する契約・法律行為（直接取引および間接取引）という取引・契約そのものを指し、業務や行政上の工程・ワークフローを表す「procedure（手続）」ではありません。

audit.term: コーポレートガバナンス
audit.reason: Corporate governance (企業統治) refers to the institutional framework, mechanisms, and principles by which corporations are directed and controlled, not a discrete operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
The suffix '書' denotes an internal business proposal form or document circulated to obtain collective consensus and managerial approval within a Japanese organization.

決裁 refers to the formal administrative or corporate approval workflow whereby an authorized executive or manager sanctions a proposed action (決裁手続). It accurately fits the definition of an administrative/operational procedure.

職務権限規程 refers to codified internal corporate regulations/bylaws defining the delegation and limits of administrative authority, representing a governance document or internal rule rather than an operational workflow or procedure.

定款 (Articles of Incorporation) is the fundamental constitutional document of a corporation governed by the Companies Act, not a procedure or operational workflow. It correctly classifies as a statutory_document (or document).

商業登記 refers to the statutory and administrative registration procedure by which commercial and corporate matters are officially recorded in the public registry pursuant to the Commercial Registration Act (商業登記法). It fits the 'procedure' class appropriately.

履歴事項全部証明書 is an official certificate of commercial registration issued by the Legal Affairs Bureau pursuant to the Commercial Registration Act; it should be classified specifically as statutory_document rather than a general business document.
印鑑証明書 is an official certificate/document certifying seal registration, appropriately classified under document (or statutory_document).
契約書は法的合意の内容を具現化した書面（処分証書）であり、法的三面関係や合意自体を表す「contract（契約・協定）」ではなく「document（文書）」に分類するのが適切である。
秘密保持契約 (NDA) is a legally binding commercial agreement between parties to safeguard confidential information, perfectly matching the 'contract' semantic class.
業務委託契約書 represents an outsourcing service agreement and is accurately classified under contract (or document).
雇用契約書 directly denotes a written employment agreement/contract, correctly aligning with the contract class for agreement execution, terms, and labor compliance collocations.
賃貸借契約書 specifically designates the physical or digital contract document rather than the abstract legal agreement itself.

While '売買契約' refers to the legal agreement or juridical relationship ('contract'), '売買契約書' specifically designates the tangible or electronic legal instrument/form ('document') prepared, executed, stamped, and retained by the parties.

合意書 is a written instrument/document formalizing a mutual agreement between parties, fitting squarely under 'document' (or 'contract'). As 'document' encompasses contractual instruments and business agreements in this taxonomy, the current classification is accurate.

覚書 (memorandum of understanding / addendum) is a formal business and legal instrument exchanged between parties to document mutual agreement or amend/supplement existing contracts, squarely fitting the 'document' class.
契約締結 refers to the operational and legal procedure of concluding or executing a contract, rather than the contract document or agreement entity itself.

甲乙関係 refers to the contractual relationship or dynamic between contracting parties (Party A and Party B), often highlighting legal status or commercial power balance. It is a relationship or legal/commercial status concept, not an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
解除権 (right of rescission/termination) is a substantive formative legal right (形成権) under the Civil Code and contract law, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).
契約不適合責任 refers to statutory/contractual liability for non-conformity (warranty) or the associated clause in an agreement, rather than an entire contractual agreement (contract).
「損害賠償請求」は不法行為や債務不履行に基づき金銭等の賠償を求める法的手続き・業務行為であり、提供された分類体系における手続的ワークフロー（procedure）として妥当です。
「免責条項」は契約書等において当事者の法的責任を免除または制限・限定する個別の条項を指し、オントロジーの「contract_clause」に完全に合致する。
不可抗力条項 explicitly denotes a force majeure clause within commercial and international contracts, precisely matching the definition and examples of the contract_clause semantic class.

準拠法 (governing law) designates the applicable legal system governing an agreement or cross-border transaction and standardly functions as a contractual stipulation/clause in commercial contracts, not an operational or administrative procedure.

管轄裁判所 denotes a judicial body/court possessing territorial or subject-matter jurisdiction over a dispute, making it a judicial government organ rather than an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

知的財産権 (Intellectual Property Rights) represents legal rights over intellectual creations (patents, trademarks, copyrights, etc.) categorized ontologically and in corporate accounting as intangible assets, not an administrative or operational procedure.
著作権 (copyright) is an intellectual property right classified as an intangible fixed asset (無形固定資産) in business and financial accounting, not an operational procedure.
特許権 (patent right) is a statutory intellectual property right classified as an intangible fixed asset (無形固定資産) on the balance sheet under J-GAAP, IFRS, and the Companies Act.
商標権 (trademark right) is an intellectual property right classified as an intangible fixed asset (無形固定資産) under Japanese GAAP and corporate accounting standards.
「ライセンス契約」は知的財産権等の使用許諾を定める法的合意・契約そのものを指し、タクソノミー上の「contract」クラスに正確に合致する。
守秘義務 standardly designates a confidentiality obligation or covenant within commercial agreements and professional codes.
「契約更新」は契約書そのもの（合意文書・法律関係）を指す名詞ではなく、契約期間の延長や再契約を行う事務的・法的な手続き・プロセス（業務フロー）であるため、contractではなくprocedureが適切です。
「自動更新条項」は契約書等に規定される契約期間の自動延長に関する個別条項であり、契約条項分類（contract_clause）として完全に合致している。
違約金 (penalty for breach of contract) is a monetary amount, expense/loss (支払違約金), or revenue/gain (受取違約金) item on financial statements, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

債務不履行 (default/breach of obligation) is a legal condition or substantive civil law concept (Civil Code Art. 415) representing the failure to perform a contractual duty, not an operational or administrative procedure.

audit.term: 反社会的勢力排除条項
audit.reason: 反社会的勢力排除条項（暴排条項）は、取引相手が反社会的勢力であることが判明した場合に契約解除等を可能にする標準的な契約条項であり、contract_clause として適切です。
Defined statutorily as an operational measure to verify record integrity and authorship, fitting administrative and legal execution procedures.
押印 refers to the formal administrative and legal operational action of affixing a seal to validate a document, which correctly falls under the procedure class.

就業規則 (employment regulations / work rules) represents a formal written code and regulatory document governing terms of employment and workplace discipline (statutorily required under Article 89 of the Labor Standards Act for workplaces with 10 or more employees), not an administrative workflow or procedure.
雇用形態 denotes the contractual classification or category of labor/employment (e.g., regular employee, contract worker, part-time), not an administrative workflow or operational process (procedure).
正社員 designates a regular, permanent employment status and role held by an individual within an enterprise, correctly aligning with person_role.
契約社員は有期労働契約に基づき就労する自然人（雇用形態・人的主体）を指すため、合意・契約概念である「contract」ではなく「person_role」が適切。
「派遣社員」は労働者派遣法に基づき派遣元と雇用関係を結び派遣先で就労する人的主体・雇用形態上の役割区分を指すため、person_roleとして正確に分類されている。
パートタイマー denotes a category of employee or worker under Japanese labor and HR practices, making it an animate human role (person_role), not an administrative workflow or procedure.
業務委託は行政的・事務的ワークフロー（procedure）ではなく、民法上の請負や準委任等に基づく外部委託の契約形態（業務委託契約）または就労・取引形態を表すため、`contract`に分類するのが適切です。

試用期間 (probationary period) represents a contractual condition and duration stipulated in employment contracts and work rules (legally interpreted as a contract with reserved right of termination / 解約権留保付労働契約). It is a contractual term or condition, not an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
「労働条件通知書」は労働基準法第15条に基づき使用者が労働者に交付する書面（法定書面・通知書）であり、document（または法定文書を細分化する場合は statutory_document）として正確に分類されています。

基本給 (base salary / basic pay) is a fundamental remuneration component and payroll expense item (typically booked under 給料手当/人件費 in the income statement), not an operational workflow or administrative procedure.
役職手当 (position allowance / managerial allowance) is a payroll component and an expense line item (sub-account under 給与手当/人件費 in SG&A or cost of labor), not an operational or administrative procedure.
通勤手当 (commuting allowance) is an employee payroll allowance and an accounting expense item (sub-account under 給料手当, 福利厚生費, or 旅費交通費), not an operational workflow or procedure.
残業手当（割増賃金・超過勤務手当）は業務手続（procedure）ではなく、給与計算や財務会計における人件費・給与手当の費目（費用勘定・内訳項目）に該当するため。
深夜手当 is a statutory late-night wage allowance (割増賃金) governed by Article 37 of the Labor Standards Act, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).
休日出勤手当 (holiday work allowance) is a labor cost/payroll allowance item classified as an expense line item (人件費/給与手当), not an administrative workflow or procedure.
固定残業代 refers to a fixed overtime allowance or wage component paid to employees, rather than an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).

裁量労働制 is a statutory working-hour regime regulated under the Labor Standards Act (労働基準法), not an administrative workflow or procedural sequence. It properly belongs to a labor or employment scheme class.

変形労働時間制 is a statutory working hours regime established under the Labor Standards Act (労働基準法), not an operational or administrative workflow (procedure). By analogy with tax_scheme, it constitutes a labor_scheme (or statutory_scheme).
有給休暇 refers to a statutory leave entitlement and employee benefit under the Labor Standards Act (労働基準法第39条), rather than an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

特別休暇 (special leave) denotes a non-statutory leave entitlement or HR welfare provision (e.g., condolence or refresh leave), not an administrative workflow or procedural step. Its primary collocations involve entitlement and granting (付与する, 取得する, 規定する) rather than procedural execution.
産前産後休業は労働基準法第65条に定められた法定休業（制度・権利）であり、申請や届出などの行政・社内実務プロセス（procedure）そのものではなく、法定休業制度・地位（statutory_leave / statutory_scheme）として分類するのが適切です。
育児休業は育児・介護休業法に基づく法定の休業制度（労働義務が免除される期間および就業状態）であり、申請等の作業フローを指す「procedure（手続き）」ではなく「statutory_leave（法定休業）」に分類すべきである。
介護休業は育児・介護休業法に定められた法定の休業制度（権利・ステータス）であり、申請手続き等の事務・業務プロセス（procedure）そのものではないため、statutory_leave（またはemployee_benefit）が適切。

社会保険 (Social Insurance) refers to the institutional public insurance framework or statutory insurance system (health insurance, welfare pension, etc.), not an operational workflow or procedure. Procedural actions (such as 加入手続き) should be distinguished from the scheme itself.

厚生年金保険 is a statutory public pension/social insurance system (公的年金・社会保険制度), not an administrative workflow or procedure. 'procedure' corresponds to filings or administrative steps such as 資格取得手続き or 算定基礎届提出.
健康保険 (Health Insurance) is a statutory social insurance scheme/program (社会保険制度), not an administrative workflow or procedure.
雇用保険 is a statutory public insurance scheme (specifically labor insurance), not an administrative workflow or procedure. Procedural actions would be denoted by terms like 雇用保険適用手続き or 資格取得届.

労災保険 (労働者災害補償保険) is a statutory labor/social insurance system (scheme), not an administrative workflow or procedure. Collocations and predicates govern coverage, enrollment, and premium liability (e.g., 労災保険が適用される, 労災保険料を負担する).
住民税特別徴収は、地方税法に基づき給与支払者が従業員の給与から個人住民税を天引きして各市区町村に納入する法定の税徴収制度（普通徴収と対比される制度枠組み）であり、汎用的なprocedureではなくtax_schemeに分類するのが適切です。

給与明細 (payslip / salary statement) is a business record and written statement issued to an employee detailing earnings, deductions, and net pay. It is an artifact/document, not a procedure or workflow.
差引支給額 (net pay / take-home pay) is a calculated monetary amount or payroll figure (総支給額 minus 控除合計額), not an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
勤怠管理 represents an operational and administrative HR workflow for tracking employee working hours, leave, and attendance, which accurately fits the definition of 'procedure'.
タイムカード (time card) is a physical or electronic business form/record used to log working hours, not the administrative workflow itself (which would be 打刻 or 勤怠管理). It correctly classifies as document.
「欠勤」は労働義務のある日に出勤しないという勤怠区分・就業状態（attendance status/labor event）を表す概念であり、業務上の「手続き（procedure）」ではありません。手続きに該当するのは「欠勤届」「欠勤申請」などです。
遅刻 (tardiness) represents an attendance status or labor compliance event (勤怠状況・服務規程上の事由), not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).
「早退」は就業規則や勤怠管理における勤怠区分・就労事象（遅刻・欠勤と同種）であり、業務上の手続・ワークフローそのものを指す「procedure」ではない（手続きを指す場合は「早退手続」「早退届」となる）。

退職届 designates the formal written instrument or notice of resignation submitted by an employee, representing a business document rather than the operational resignation workflow or administrative process (退職手続).
Disciplinary dismissal is a formal HR and legal termination workflow, correctly fitting the general procedure class.

整理解雇 (redundancy dismissal/layoff) is an employer-initiated labor and corporate operational workflow subject to strict statutory/case law criteria (整理解雇の4要件). In the absence of a dedicated labor class, 'procedure' correctly captures this operational/legal process.

退職金 (severance pay / retirement allowance) represents employee/executive compensation and functions as an expense line item (勘定科目) on the income statement, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

見込み客 (prospective customer / sales lead) designates an individual or corporate counterparty category in marketing and sales, not a workflow or process. Under the ontology taxonomy, it properly classifies as a person_role.

商談 refers to commercial negotiations, sales meetings, or business discussions rather than a formal administrative or regulatory procedure (手続き). In business management ontologies, it is more accurately categorized as a business practice or commercial activity.

In Japanese commercial and corporate contexts, securing an 'アポイントメント' (pre-arranged meeting) is a foundational business practice and protocol (商習慣・ビジネスマナー) governing client visits and sales activities. The class accurately supports standard collocations such as アポイントメントを取る/取り付ける.

ヒアリング denotes an operational inquiry, information-gathering, or needs-assessment workflow widely used across business, consulting, and requirement definitions, which fits the definition of an operational procedure.
提案書 refers to a written business proposal or solution pitch submitted to clients or internal stakeholders, correctly classified as a 'document'.
A presentation or pitch is a business communication activity and commercial practice, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure/手続).
競合他社 denotes rival or competing business enterprises in the market. It represents a corporate entity (organization), not an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
差別化 (differentiation) is a core competitive and strategic management concept (e.g., competitive advantage, differentiation strategy), not an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).

顧客満足度 (Customer Satisfaction / CS) represents a quantifiable evaluation index or key performance indicator (KPI) measuring customer fulfillment, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

リード獲得 (lead generation) refers to an operational sales and marketing workflow/process designed to identify and attract potential customers. As there is no dedicated marketing-specific category in the ontology, it accurately falls under 'procedure' (administrative or operational workflows).

クロージング represents the formal execution phase or completion workflow of a transaction, M&A deal, or sales process, accurately fitting the operational and administrative workflow definition of 'procedure'.
「成約」は契約の成立または成立した取引・契約自体（合意の成立）を指す語であり、事務的な業務フローや手続き（procedure）ではなく「contract」に分類するのが適切。
失注 (lost order / deal lost) denotes a sales outcome or deal milestone where an opportunity fails to convert, rather than a planned administrative workflow or operational procedure.
アフターサービスは一連の手順や行政・社内手続（procedure）ではなく、製品販売後に顧客へ提供される保守・点検・修理等の付帯役務（service）であるため。
リピート率 represents the repeat purchase rate, which is a quantitative KPI and operational business metric measuring customer retention and sales performance.
解約率 (churn rate) is an operational KPI and quantitative business metric measuring the proportion of contract cancellations over a given timeframe.
顧客生涯価値 (Customer Lifetime Value / LTV) は業務・マーケティング上の評価指標・KPI（metric）であり、業務手順や手続き（procedure）ではありません。
市場調査 (market research) is an operational and analytical workflow for collecting and analyzing market data, appropriately categorized under the general 'procedure' class within the ontology.
「ターゲット層」 refers to a target demographic or customer group in marketing and business strategy, representing a market segment rather than an operational or administrative workflow (procedure).
販路開拓は定型的な事務処理や認可手続（procedure）ではなく、顧客網や流通チャネルを開拓・拡大する戦略的な事業・営業活動（business activity/initiative）であるため。
「代理店契約」is a commercial agreement governing an agency or distributorship relationship, making 'contract' the exact and appropriate semantic class.
フランチャイズ（franchise）は本部（フランチャイザー）と加盟店（フランチャイジー）の間で展開される事業形態・商業システム（ビジネスモデル）であり、業務手順や事務フローを表す「procedure」への分類は不適切です。
「協業」は申請や処理などの定型的な事務手順・工程（procedure）ではなく、企業間での協力・提携関係や共同事業の取り組みを表す業務形態・商慣行概念であるため。
アライアンス（戦略的提携・業務提携）は業務上の処理手順（procedure）ではなく、複数の企業が相互の利益や競争力強化のために結ぶ協力関係や経営戦略（business_strategy）に該当するため。
販売促進（セールスプロモーション）は定型的な事務・行政手順（procedure）ではなく、顧客の購買意欲を喚起して売上拡大を図る広範な商業・マーケティング活動（business practice）であるため。

キャンペーン refers to a planned marketing initiative or promotional drive (販促活動・宣伝企画), not an administrative or operational workflow (手続・手順). It should be classified as marketing_activity or sales_promotion rather than procedure.

価格交渉 (price negotiation) refers to an interactive commercial practice and operational activity between transacting parties, rather than a formalized administrative or operational procedure (手続き/手順). It is best classified as business_practice.
「予算達成率」 is a performance indicator (KPI) and operational ratio measuring actual business results against budgeted targets, which aligns precisely with the 'metric' semantic class.
売上目標 (sales target/revenue goal) is a key performance indicator (KPI) and operational business target, correctly classified under metric.
KPI (Key Performance Indicator) represents a quantifiable operational and business performance indicator, fitting the 'metric' semantic class perfectly.

パイプライン管理 (sales pipeline management) refers to the operational workflow and process of tracking, managing, and standardizing deals across the sales cycle, fitting the taxonomy definition of operational workflows under 'procedure'.
顧客台帳は顧客の属性情報や取引履歴を記録・管理する帳簿・台帳（文書・記録物）であり、業務プロセスや手続きを表すprocedureではなく「document」が適切である。

受注残 (order backlog) represents the quantitative or monetary balance of unfulfilled orders; it functions as an operational indicator and forward-looking financial KPI, not an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).
キーパーソン refers to an influential stakeholder or key decision maker (a person or role within an organization/business transaction), not a workflow or procedure.
「紹介営業」は業務上の手続き（procedure）ではなく、既存顧客や知人の紹介を活用して新規開拓を行う営業手法・商慣行であるため、business_practiceが適切。

資金調達 denotes the managerial and operational process/workflow of procuring funds (financing/fundraising) through equity, debt, or other financial methods. In the absence of a dedicated corporate finance category, 'procedure' accurately captures this operational workflow without violating ontologic constraints.
「シード期」はスタートアップや新規事業の成長段階・開発フェーズ（シード、アーリー、ミドル、レイター等）を表す概念であり、業務手続きやワークフローを指す「procedure」ではないため、「business_stage」（または「lifecycle_stage」）が適切です。

audit.term: ベンチャーキャピタル
audit.reason: ベンチャーキャピタル（VC）は未公開スタートアップ企業等への投資や育成を行う投資会社・事業法人組織を指すエンティティであり、手続きや業務フローを表す「procedure」ではなく「organization」に分類するのが適切です。

エンジェル投資家 refers to an individual investor who provides early-stage capital to startups, representing an investor or business role (person_role) rather than an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

A pitch deck (ピッチデック) is a presentation slide deck or document used to summarize a business plan for investors, making it an artifact/document rather than an administrative or operational workflow (procedure).

Stock options represent equity-based incentive compensation (新株予約権を活用した報酬制度・インセンティブ) granted to directors and employees under the Companies Act and tax law, not an administrative workflow or procedure.

In corporate finance and M&A, バリュエーション (company valuation) primarily refers to the analytical workflow and evaluation process of assessing the economic value of an enterprise or asset. Under the current taxonomy, 'procedure' appropriately captures this specialized appraisal workflow.
バーンレート（burn rate）はスタートアップ企業等における月々の資金減少ペースを示す経営・財務指標（KPI）であり、手続き（procedure）ではなく指標（metric）に分類するのが適切である。

In startup finance and corporate management, 'ランウェイ' (runway) refers to the quantifiable duration (typically in months) a company can operate before exhausting its cash reserves, calculated from cash balance and net burn rate. It is a financial operational metric (KPI), not a procedure.

The suffix '化' transforms the concept from an attribute/metric (業務効率) into an action, initiative, or operational improvement process (operational streamlining/optimization). It functions as an operational workflow or initiative rather than a quantifiable measurement index.

audit.term: デジタルトランスフォーメーション
audit.reason: Digital Transformation (DX) is an overarching corporate/business transformation and strategic management framework, not an administrative or operational procedure (手続き/業務手順).
テレワーク denotes a working modality or operational arrangement (勤務形態・働き方), not an administrative or operational sequential workflow (procedure).

業務引き継ぎ refers to the operational workflow and administrative process of transferring duties, pending tasks, and responsibilities from a predecessor to a successor, fitting the definition of an internal operational procedure.

情報セキュリティ refers to the preservation of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information, representing a broad risk management and corporate governance discipline rather than an individual administrative workflow or procedure.
個人情報保護法 is a formal statutory act (Act on the Protection of Personal Information), not an operational or administrative workflow; therefore, it belongs to statutory_law rather than procedure.

プライバシーマーク (P-Mark) represents a third-party certification and registered trust mark granted by JIPDEC for personal data protection compliance (JIS Q 15001), not an operational or administrative procedure.
秘密保持誓約書 is a unilateral written pledge/instrument (誓約書) executed by an employee or counterparty to ensure confidentiality, fitting accurately under the 'document' class.
会議議事録 refers to business meeting minutes, which is an internal operational record correctly classified under document.
業務フロー directly denotes an operational or administrative workflow, aligning accurately with the taxonomy's definition of 'procedure'.
マニュアル作成 represents an operational workflow and administrative task of compiling standard operating procedures (SOPs), which accurately falls under the definition of procedure.
予実管理 (budget vs. actual management / budgetary control) is an operational and managerial workflow involving variance tracking and corrective action, which appropriately falls under 'procedure'.
「経費精算」は従業員が立替払いした業務費用を事後的に精算・払戻しする社内管理実務・業務フローを指すため、行政・業務手続全般を包括する「procedure」が適切である。
「立替精算」 refers to the administrative and operational business workflow of reimbursing expenses paid out-of-pocket by employees, correctly classified as a procedure.

出張申請 refers to the internal administrative procedure and approval workflow required prior to undertaking business travel, distinguishing it from the physical or electronic form itself (出張申請書), which would be classified as a document.
「直行直帰」は日本の企業組織における典型的な就業形態・業務慣行であり、`business_practice` の分類が正確に実態を表しています。

朝礼 (morning meeting/assembly) is a traditional, institutionalized corporate routine and workflow convention in Japanese workplaces, aligning directly with the business_practice class alongside concepts like 報連相 and 根回し.
定例会議 (regular/periodic meeting) represents a standard operational communication routine and internal business practice within corporate workflows.

進捗報告 is a standard workplace communication routine and core element of 報連相 (report-contact-consult), making business_practice a more precise ontological classification than the broader administrative category of procedure (while written reports are typically 進捗報告書, falling under document).
「報連相」（報告・連絡・相談）は日本の企業文化・組織運営における基本原則および業務コミュニケーション慣例であり、business_practice の分類が完全に合致します。
根回し is an informal consensus-building process characteristic of traditional Japanese corporate culture, perfectly matching the business_practice semantic class.

社内規定 refers to codified internal company regulations, bylaws, or normative policy instruments rather than an operational workflow or action sequence (procedure). It accurately classifies as a document.

備品 (fixtures/equipment) is an asset, but 備品管理 refers to the operational and administrative task of managing company equipment and supplies, making 'procedure' the correct semantic class rather than 'depreciable_asset'.
原状回復 refers to the operational workflow and process of restoring a leased property or asset to its original state upon contract termination, fitting the definition of an operational procedure.
敷金 (security deposit) is a balance sheet asset account categorized under investments and other assets (投資その他の資産), not an operational workflow or procedure.

保証金 represents guarantee money or security deposit, which is a balance sheet asset or liability line item (e.g., 差入保証金 under 投資その他の資産 or 預り保証金 under 固定負債), not an operational or administrative procedure.
「国税」は国が賦課・徴収する租税の総称・分類概念であり、地方税と対比される税区分として semantic class `tax` に合致している。

地方税 (local tax) refers to the category of taxes levied by local public entities (prefectures and municipalities) in contrast to 国税 (national tax), and is accurately categorized under the semantic class `tax`.
「直接税」 (direct tax) represents a primary classification/category of tax where the statutory taxpayer and economic bearer are identical (e.g., 法人税, 所得税), fitting the 'tax' semantic class.

間接税 refers to indirect tax (taxes where the statutory taxpayer differs from the economic bearer, such as consumption tax or liquor tax), which is a fundamental tax classification correctly assigned to the 'tax' semantic class.
「納税義務者」は税法上において税を納める義務を負う自然人または法人（納税者）という主体の属性・役割を指す概念であり、「contract_clause（契約条項）」ではなく「person_role（納税者・当事者役割）」に分類するのが適切です。
課税標準 (tax base) is not a tax type/levy (tax) itself, but the statutory monetary or quantitative base upon which tax rates are applied to calculate tax liability.
課税所得は法人税や所得税などの税目（tax）そのものではなく、税額算出の基礎となる課税標準・計算概念（益金引く損金、または総所得金額等から各種控除を引いた金額）であるため、taxable_income_elementに分類すべきである。
「非課税」は消費税や法人税のような具体的な税目（tax）そのものではなく、特定の取引や所得に課税権を行使しない税務上の区分・取扱いを表す概念であるため、tax_treatment（またはtax_status）が適切。
不課税 is not a tax type (such as income tax or consumption tax), but a tax classification (課税区分) or taxability status indicating transactions that fall outside the statutory scope of taxation.
「免税」は税目（法人税・消費税などの個別税目）そのものではなく、課税義務を免除する法定制度・税務上の優遇措置（輸出免税や旅行者免税制度など）を指すため、'tax'ではなく'tax_scheme'が適切です。
軽減税率 refers to the reduced consumption tax rate system (8%) under Japanese domestic tax law, rather than an import customs tariff (関税率). It should be categorized under tax_scheme.

標準税率 refers to the statutory standard tax rate applied in domestic taxation (e.g., the 10% standard consumption tax rate vs. 軽減税率, or local standard tax rates under the Local Tax Act), not an import tariff (関税率). Classifying it as customs_tariff is incorrect.

納税地 (place of tax payment) is a statutory legal location/jurisdiction under Japanese tax law (such as 所得税法第15条 or 法人税法第16条) that determines the competent tax office (所轄税務署), not an administrative procedure or workflow.
「申告納税制度」は納税者が自ら所得や税額を計算して申告・納付する税法上の基本体制・制度枠組み（tax regime/system）であり、tax_schemeへの分類が正確である。
「賦課課税制度」は、税務当局が税額を計算・決定して納税者に通知する公的な課税方式・制度であり、申告納税制度と並ぶ基幹的な課税レジームであるため、tax_schemeの分類が完全に適切です。
予定納税 is not an independent tax type (税目) such as income tax or corporate tax, but rather a statutory tax prepayment regime/mechanism (制度) stipulated under the Income Tax Act.
中間申告 refers to an interim tax return filing procedure under Japanese tax law (such as Corporate Tax or Consumption Tax), which precisely matches the tax_filing class alongside 確定申告.

確定申告 is the statutory process of declaring income and filing an annual final tax return to determine tax liability, directly matching the specialized class 'tax_filing' (explicitly cited as an archetype).
還付申告 refers to the statutory tax return filing process undertaken by a taxpayer to claim a refund of overpaid taxes (e.g., under Article 122 of the Income Tax Act), fitting directly under tax_filing.
修正申告 is the statutory tax filing procedure under the General Law of National Taxes (国税通則法第19条) used to correct an underreported tax amount, making 'tax_filing' the exact semantic class.
所得税 (income tax) represents a primary statutory national tax category imposed on individual income, accurately aligning with the semantic class 'tax'.
「復興特別所得税」は東日本大震災の復興財源確保のために創設された国税の税目（特別国税）であり、分類クラスとして「tax」が正確かつ適切です。
利子所得 precisely designates one of the ten statutory income classifications (所得区分) under Article 23 of the Japanese Income Tax Act (所得税法).

配当所得 (dividend income) is one of the ten statutory categories of personal income explicitly established under Article 23 of the Japanese Income Tax Act (所得税法), making 'income_classification' an accurate classification.
Under Japanese Income Tax Act (所得税法第26条), 不動産所得 is one of the ten statutory categories of income (所得区分). Classifying it as 'income_classification' is accurate and domain-appropriate.
